events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_full $6.61 (model confidence 0.93)
events.body:
This is a rider-side cancellation of an instant RydeX booking, so the fee can only be justified through NS-0's rider branch, i.e. NS-4 [F2][F5][NS-0]. NS-4 charges $6.61 only when the rider cancels more than 3 minutes after matching, and it expressly makes cancellation free within the first 3 minutes [F2][NS-4].

The trace settles that branch: the booking was accepted at 12:54:00 and the rider cancelled at 12:55:40, i.e. 1 min 40 s (100 s) after matching, which is inside the 3-minute free window [F2][NS-4]. The recorded $6.61 cancellation fee [F5] therefore has no basis under NS-4 and must be returned in full [F2][F5][NS-4].

The alternative route to a cancellation fee — driver-side no-show — is unavailable on these facts. The driver never tapped "I'm Here" [F4], the platform never recorded arrival [F3], and GPS shows the closest approach was 2597 m, never within 200 m of the pickup point [F1]; NS-1's conditions (i) and (ii) accordingly fail [F4][F1][NS-1]. Because the fee was charged to the rider despite the rider's timely cancellation, the correct outcome is refund_full of $6.61, consistent with the trace's allowed outcome and amount [F5][NS-4].

The driver's account is not flagged: NS-2's flag attaches only where the driver pressed "I'm Here" while GPS shows him outside the pickup radius, and here no "I'm Here" tap exists at all [F4][F1][NS-2]. The driver's statement that he "was on his way" [F8] does not alter the analysis, since it confirms only that he had not arrived, and no traffic-inconvenience excuse is needed because no fee can be charged in the free-cancellation window regardless of conditions such as the fair weather and clear traffic records [F9][F10][F11][NS-4]. The profile facts (rider and driver dispute histories) do not decide the case and are not needed for any account action [F12][F13][RD-6].

events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: Good news — your $6.61 cancellation fee has been refunded in full as a Ryde voucher.

You cancelled 1 minute 40 seconds after a driver accepted your ride. Cancelling within the first 3 minutes is free, so the fee should never have been charged.

The voucher will be applied to your account and used automatically on your next Ryde trip. No action is needed from you, and there is no mark against your account.

DRIVER: We reviewed the cancellation fee on this trip. The fee was charged to the rider and has been refunded to them in full as a Ryde voucher.

The rider cancelled 1 minute 40 seconds after you accepted, which falls inside the free cancellation window, so no fee could be charged for this trip.

No action has been taken against your account. There is no hold, penalty, or flag on your driver profile, and you can keep accepting trips as usual.
